name: avatar-picker
title: Avatar Picker
description: Upload, change or remove a person's photo — a large PersonAvatar with a busy spinner, Upload/Change photo through the file picker, Remove, and a line for a refused file.

meta.whenToUse: A profile or member settings row where someone sets their own photo.
meta.whenNotToUse: Attaching files to a record (Dropzone / Attachment) or picking a person (SearchableSelect).
